tracesTo: SOW: Tech Stack - Sleeper public API

stories.title: Fetch League Data via Sleeper API
stories.goal: retrieve comprehensive league configuration and settings from Sleeper API
stories.benefit: FSHQ maintains accurate league information for display and synchronization
acceptanceCriteria: System calls Sleeper API GET /league/{league_id} to fetch league metadata
System retrieves league name, season, avatar, scoring settings, roster positions, and playoff configuration
System stores league data with version timestamp for tracking changes
System handles API errors gracefully with retry logic and error logging
System validates API response structure before processing

stories.title: Fetch Team Rosters and Owner Information
stories.goal: retrieve all team rosters and their associated owners from Sleeper
stories.benefit: FSHQ can display current team compositions and link teams to owners
acceptanceCriteria: System calls Sleeper API GET /league/{league_id}/rosters to fetch all rosters
System retrieves roster_id, owner_id, players, starters, reserve, taxi squad, wins, losses, and points
System calls GET /league/{league_id}/users to fetch owner display names and avatars
System maps roster data to FSHQ team entities using roster_id as external reference
System handles rosters without owners (orphaned teams) appropriately

stories.title: Fetch Weekly Matchup Schedule
stories.goal: retrieve the complete matchup schedule for all weeks of the season
stories.benefit: FSHQ can display weekly matchups and track season progression
acceptanceCriteria: System calls Sleeper API GET /league/{league_id}/matchups/{week} for each week of the season
System retrieves matchup_id, roster_id, points, and custom_points for each matchup
System determines total number of weeks from league settings (regular season + playoffs)
System stores matchup data with week number and matchup pairings
System identifies playoff weeks based on league playoff configuration

stories.title: Fetch League Transactions
stories.goal: retrieve all transactions including trades, waivers, and free agent pickups
stories.benefit: FSHQ can display transaction history and generate transaction moments for the newsfeed
acceptanceCriteria: System calls Sleeper API GET /league/{league_id}/transactions/{round} to fetch transactions
System retrieves transaction type (trade, waiver, free_agent), status, timestamp, roster_ids, players, and draft picks
System iterates through all rounds (weeks) to fetch complete transaction history
System stores transaction data with timestamps for chronological sorting
System handles different transaction types (trade vs waiver vs free agent) appropriately

stories.title: Fetch Match Results and Scoring
stories.goal: retrieve final match scores and player performance data for completed matchups
stories.benefit: FSHQ can display accurate results and generate match result moments
acceptanceCriteria: System calls GET /league/{league_id}/matchups/{week} to fetch matchup results
System retrieves final points scored by each team in each matchup
System identifies winners and losers based on points comparison
System detects stat corrections by comparing points across multiple fetches
System stores match results with completion timestamps

stories.title: Handle Sleeper API Rate Limits
stories.goal: respect Sleeper API rate limits and handle throttling gracefully
stories.benefit: FSHQ maintains reliable API access without being blocked or throttled
acceptanceCriteria: System implements rate limiting to stay within Sleeper API limits (1000 requests per minute)
System includes exponential backoff retry logic when rate limited
System queues API requests when approaching rate limits
System logs rate limit events for monitoring and optimization
System prioritizes critical API calls (match results) over historical data fetches

stories.title: Fetch Draft Results and Draft Picks
stories.goal: retrieve complete draft history including all picks and pick trades
stories.benefit: FSHQ can display draft results and track pick trades for dynasty leagues
acceptanceCriteria: System calls GET /league/{league_id}/drafts to get list of drafts for league
System calls GET /draft/{draft_id}/picks to fetch all draft picks in order
System retrieves pick number, player_id, roster_id, and pick metadata
System stores draft results with timestamps and draft type (snake, linear, auction)
System handles traded picks and tracks original vs current pick ownership

stories.title: Fetch Playoff Bracket Structure
stories.goal: retrieve playoff bracket configuration and progression
stories.benefit: FSHQ can display accurate playoff brackets with winners and losers brackets
acceptanceCriteria: System determines playoff structure from league settings (teams, rounds, bracket type)
System fetches playoff matchups using GET /league/{league_id}/matchups/{week} for playoff weeks
System identifies winners bracket vs losers/toilet bracket matchups
System tracks bracket progression and determines playoff seeding
System handles different playoff formats (single elimination, consolation bracket)

stories.title: Fetch Current NFL Season State
stories.goal: retrieve current NFL week, season type, and season year
stories.benefit: FSHQ can determine which week is active and adjust sync frequency accordingly
acceptanceCriteria: System calls GET /state/nfl to fetch current NFL season state
System retrieves season, season_type (pre, regular, post), week, and previous_season
System uses season state to determine if league is active and which weeks need syncing
System adjusts sync frequency based on season phase (active vs offseason)
System stores season state with timestamp for tracking changes

stories.title: Fetch Player Metadata for Roster Display
stories.goal: retrieve player information for displaying rosters and transactions
stories.benefit: FSHQ can show player names, positions, and teams in roster and transaction views
acceptanceCriteria: System calls GET /players/nfl to fetch comprehensive player database
System retrieves player_id, full_name, position, team, status, and injury information
System caches player data locally to reduce API calls
System updates player data weekly during season to capture status changes
System handles player transactions (team changes, status updates) appropriately
